title: Winnie S NDE 4453
content: After observing a frightening injury of a loved one, I ran as fast as I could to summon help. Upon returning to the scene, I felt a feeling of light-headedness and my heart was racing and my ears ringing. Then I experienced darkness and then proceeded to the indescribably bright light. The scene was a pastoral setting with brilliant colors but not distinguishable as flowers or objects. Approaching me were beings that I can only describe as individual entities that appeared to be bright, not earthy beings, familiar but not identifiable to me. They welcomed me and the light presence gave a feeling of love and peace and knowing that I have never felt before. The communication was not in words but in thoughts. I did not want to leave the place or feeling but I was aware of a floating feeling back into by physical body and my husband desperately trying to revive me. I hesitated to come back but knew that I had to try to get back. Something told me that I had to try to help my husband who was attending to me. Obviously, I came back but my husband reported that I had stopped breathing and my eyes were open and fixated and I lost bladder control and of course muscle control. When I had gone limp, he had laid me down on the ground. My husband, an Orthodontist, thought that I was dead. I returned to my physical body before the Emergency Medical Services arrived or before my husband had started CPR. I was taken to our room, vital signs were taken, and I was asked if I wanted to go to the hospital. I declined. When I returned home, to the states, I did see my family physician and had a cardiologist follow-up. All tests were within the normal range. I must say, I think about this experience daily. It has changed my life in a positive way. I feel that the message that I received was one of love and I feel compelled to express and show loving kindness in every way that I can. I have recently retired. Although I have always done volunteer work for various causes, I now have had Hospice training and am working with folks in their later stages of life. I feel a spirituality that I never felt before and a serenity that I have never felt before. I also have shared my experience with only a few people and after reading about Dr. Long's research, felt that it was a good opportunity to share with more people.
